description: This Java class defines a generic collection for combining multiple EntityCondition instances with a logical operator, typically for building complex query conditions in an ORM or database abstraction layer.

classes.name: EntityConditionList
classes.description: A final class that extends EntityConditionListBase to hold a list of EntityCondition objects combined with an operator.

methods.name: EntityConditionList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition list with a collection of conditions and a join operator.

methods.name: getConditionListSize
methods.description: Returns the number of conditions in the list.

methods.name: getConditionIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the list of conditions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing EntityConditionVisitor for processing.
